title: Pass 3 reference table: cholesteric chitin-fibroin liquid-crystal lamellar precursor (Cartwright et al. 2009) coupled to BCF screw-dislocation terraces, and brick-and-mortar aragonite tablet-sliding tension-shear-chain fracture mechanics (Jackson et al. 1988; Currey 1977; Gao et al. 2003; Ji & Gao 2004; Barthelat et al. 2007; Wang et al. 2001)
provenance_note: All numeric values below were transcribed offline from the cited papers (no network access during Pass 3). Values marked 'approx' are order-of-magnitude literature ranges, not digitised figure points, and must be re-verified against the papers in a later pass.

sources.citation: Cartwright JHE, Checa AG, Escribano B, Sainz-Diaz CI (2009). Spiral and target patterns in bivalve nacre. PNAS 106(26):10499-10504.
sources.role: Cholesteric chitin liquid-crystal interlamellar membrane hypothesis: membrane period = cholesteric half-pitch P/2; spiral/target patterns as screw-dislocation defects of the layered liquid-crystal stack

sources.citation: Cartwright JHE, Checa AG (2007). The dynamics of nacre self-assembly. J. R. Soc. Interface 4(14):491-504.
sources.role: Interlamellar membrane / mineral-bridge growth model; tablet thickness h_0 ~ 0.5 um

sources.citation: de Gennes PG, Prost J (1993). The Physics of Liquid Crystals, 2nd ed. Oxford University Press.
sources.role: Cholesteric director n(z) = (cos qz, sin qz, 0), q = 2 pi / P, n = -n symmetry => structural period P/2; twist n.(curl n) = -q

sources.citation: Kleman M, Lavrentovich OD (2003). Soft Matter Physics: An Introduction. Springer, New York.
sources.role: Screw dislocations in layered (smectic/cholesteric) phases: helicoidal layer displacement u = b theta / (2 pi), Burgers vector quantised in units of the layer period

sources.citation: Jackson AP, Vincent JFV, Turner RM (1988). The mechanical design of nacre. Proc. R. Soc. Lond. B 234(1277):415-440.
sources.role: Nacre tensile modulus ~73 GPa (dry) / ~64 GPa (wet), tensile strength ~170 MPa (dry) / ~140 MPa (wet), work of fracture ~350 (dry) to ~1240 (wet) J/m^2

sources.citation: Currey JD (1977). Mechanical properties of mother of pearl in tension. Proc. R. Soc. Lond. B 196(1125):443-463.
sources.role: Nacre work of fracture ~3000x that of monolithic aragonite

sources.citation: Gao H, Ji B, Jaeger IL, Arzt E, Fratzl P (2003). Materials become insensitive to flaws at nanoscale: lessons from nature. PNAS 100(10):5597-5600.
sources.role: Flaw-tolerant critical mineral thickness h* = alpha^2 Gamma E / sigma_th^2 ~ 30 nm (alpha ~ sqrt(pi), sigma_th ~ E/30)

sources.citation: Ji B, Gao H (2004). Mechanical properties of nanostructure of biological materials. J. Mech. Phys. Solids 52(9):1963-1990.
sources.role: Tension-shear chain (TSC) model: 1/E = 4(1-Phi)/(G_p Phi^2 rho^2) + 1/(Phi E_m); strength sigma = Phi rho tau_p / 2

sources.citation: Jaeger I, Fratzl P (2000). Mineralized collagen fibrils: a mechanical model with a staggered arrangement of mineral particles. Biophys. J. 79(4):1737-1746.
sources.role: Staggered brick-and-mortar shear-lag load transfer model

sources.citation: Barthelat F, Tang H, Zavattieri PD, Li C-M, Espinosa HD (2007). On the mechanics of mother-of-pearl: a key feature in the material hierarchical structure. J. Mech. Phys. Solids 55(2):306-337.
sources.role: Tablet waviness produces progressive interface hardening (dilatancy / interlocking) during tablet sliding; interface shear strength ~ 20-40 MPa (approx)

sources.citation: Wang RZ, Suo Z, Evans AG, Yao N, Aksay IA (2001). Deformation mechanisms in nacre. J. Mater. Res. 16(9):2485-2493.
sources.role: Abalone nacre tensile strength ~110 MPa with ~1% inelastic strain via tablet sliding with strain hardening (approx)

cholesteric_chitin_lamellar_precursor.section: Cartwright et al. (2009) PNAS; de Gennes & Prost (1993) Ch. 6; Kleman & Lavrentovich (2003) Ch. 8
cholesteric_chitin_lamellar_precursor.director_field: n(x,y,z) = (cos phi, sin phi, 0),  phi = (pi / h_0) * (z - u(x,y,t)),  h_0 = P / 2 (cholesteric half-pitch = interlamellar membrane period because n = -n)
cholesteric_chitin_lamellar_precursor.lamellar_density: S(x,y,z) = cos(2 phi) = cos(2 pi (z - u) / h_0): membranes (S = 1) at z = u + k h_0
cholesteric_chitin_lamellar_precursor.screw_dislocation_layer_displacement: u(x,y,t) = h_0 Phi_2D(x,y,t) / (2 pi),  Phi_2D = b theta - k_0 (r - r_c) - (omega r_c / v_inf) ln(r / r_c) + omega t  (the 2D BCF phase field); Burgers vector b_vec = oint du = b h_0 (quantised in half-pitch units)
cholesteric_chitin_lamellar_precursor.twist_rate: q = -n . (curl n) = pi / h_0 = 2 pi / P
cholesteric_chitin_lamellar_precursor.vertical_growth_rate: v_z = m h_0 omega / (2 pi) = m (P / 2) omega / (2 pi)

empirical_anchor.note: h_0 is the SEM-segmented inter-lamellar spacing of haliotis_nacre_spirals_specimen.jpg (Pass 2); P = 2 h_0 is the model-implied cholesteric pitch of the chitin-fibroin precursor, NOT an independently measured pitch.

brick_and_mortar_fracture.section: Ji & Gao (2004) Eqs. for TSC; Gao et al. (2003) Eq. 1; Barthelat et al. (2007) Sec. 4; Jackson et al. (1988) Tables 1-2; Currey (1977)
brick_and_mortar_fracture.tsc_modulus: 1 / E = 4 (1 - Phi) / (G_p Phi^2 rho^2) + 1 / (Phi E_m),  rho = L / h
brick_and_mortar_fracture.tsc_yield_strength: sigma_y = Phi rho tau_p / 2  (interface shear saturates at tau_p over overlap L_ov = L / 2)
brick_and_mortar_fracture.slip_system_schmid_law: tau_r = sigma sin(theta) cos(theta) on the interlamellar slip plane at loading angle theta; sliding when tau_r >= tau_p  =>  sigma_y(theta) = min(Phi rho tau_p / 2, tau_p / (sin theta cos theta))
brick_and_mortar_fracture.waviness_hardening: tau(s) = tau_p + H s,  H = E_n tan^2(psi) / t_m,  E_n = 2 G_p (1 + nu)  (Coulomb-dilatant interlocking of wavy tablets)
brick_and_mortar_fracture.tablet_fracture_criterion: sigma_tab,max = 2 sigma / Phi >= sigma_tab,crit = sqrt(E_m Gamma_m / (pi h / 2))  (Griffith flaw of half the tablet thickness)
brick_and_mortar_fracture.pullout_toughness: Gamma_po = tau_p L_ov^2 / h  (constant-shear tablet pull-out work per unit crack area)
brick_and_mortar_fracture.flaw_tolerance_thickness: h* = pi Gamma_m E_m / sigma_th^2,  sigma_th = E_m / 30
brick_and_mortar_fracture.ductile_brittle_aspect_ratio: rho* = sigma_tab,crit / tau_p  (rho < rho*: interface sliding precedes tablet fracture)

default_parameters.note: E_m ~ 100 GPa aragonite, G_p ~ 1.4 GPa organic mortar, tau_p = 20 MPa (within Barthelat et al. 2007 approx 20-40 MPa), psi = 1.5 deg waviness, t_m = 30 nm, Gamma_m = 1 J/m^2 (~2 gamma_s of aragonite). tau_p and psi are assumed central values within literature ranges, NOT fitted to the Jackson targets; see fracture_sweeps.
